question: Which state of India had the lowest number of districts as of September 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Goa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• As of September 2020, Goa has the lowest no. of districts.
 
• Goa is divided into 2 districts: North Goa and South Goa, which are further divided into 12 talukas.
 
• Dharbandora is the smallest taluka in the state.
 
• The Western Ghats physically divide the Deccan highlands from the state of Goa, which is located on the southwest coast of India inside the Konkan area.</li&g
